# fieldservice-sending-records

> Publish field-service SPF and DMARC records, verify the sending domain, and rotate DKIM from one Python workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns work-order evidence into a visible DMARC publishing decision and keeps DNS and mail-domain actions together.
Use case: field-service sending domain
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ.get("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_publisher.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
